brief: Fix the fan contactor chattering under load and the previously raised gasket repair that has not been completed before the heat event [SOP-016]. Because this unit's cooling type is ONAN, reduce permissible load in proportion to the lost cooling capacity [MG-021]. For this 24-year-old ageing unit, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 if it cannot be attended before the event [MG-023].
